sequence.note: 1. d4 - Control the center and open diagonals for queen and bishop.
2. Bf4 - The hallmark move of the London System, developing the bishop outside the pawn chain.
3. e3 - Solidify the d4 pawn and prepare light-squared bishop development.
4. c3 - Reinforce the d4 center pawn against Black's c5 challenge.
5. Nd2 - Support the center and prepare for kingside development.
6. Ngf3 - Develop the king's knight to its optimal square.
